method: Every679 member proposition reviewed; the repeated field template is matched exactly and each individual field/stage token checked. All original semantic payloads, source contexts,89 profiles and17564 occurrence bindings verified against immutable evidence. Mechanical equality alone does not establish retention.

decisions.EXACT_STAGE_NAME: The fixed30-stage association is unchanged. F1 adds conditional operations, not a stage or renamed ordinary task.
decisions.EXACT_LOCAL_CAPTION: The caption retains its exact immediate member set and historical supporting contexts. It does not redefine upstream governance, absorb inserted bytes or assert every child is unchanged.
decisions.DECLARED_ROLE: The stage role and producer separation remain. F1 grants neither new executor nor author/writer authority for ordinary completion; F2 changes input minimum rather than role identity.
decisions.UNCHANGED_EARLY_STAGE_OPERATION_SET: F1 starts additional failure-test routes at08 and regression routes at16. This exact Stage01–05 operation enumeration is unaffected; F2 does not grant additional operations.
decisions.CONDITIONAL_OPERATION_SET: F1 changes this formerly exhaustive later-stage operation enumeration by exactly its stage-eligible conditional pairs. Ordinary stage work, owning writers and closed receipt-only effects remain. F2 supplies route-specific input minima, not availability. Fresh effective context is required; the inherited binding qualifier remains.
decisions.PRESERVED_FIELD_CONTRACT: The field’s exact source/default contract is a literal identity/reference, canonical family projection, semantic category, objective byte fact, immutable-input selection or unchanged population predicate. Its specific definition is preserved; this does not retain any prior stored value, derivation output or runtime proof. Current acceptance/result/completeness exceptions are adjudicated separately.
decisions.COMPLETE_HUMAN_INTAKE: Complete Stage01 intake explicitly incorporates Sections6/7, so C/C1 current unit universe, A invoked fallback admission and F2 input basis become effective governors. They never replace original bytes, semantic reading or human-only authority.
decisions.SUPPLIED_ARTIFACT_INSPECTION: Every accessible supplied artifact must still be semantically inspected at its required basis. C/C1 now closes the accounting/exposure population and blockers; F2 closes external input support. Neither structural accounting nor echoes establishes inspection.
decisions.SOURCE_SEARCH_ACCEPTED_REVIEW: Current accepted search adequacy, executed search and resulting completion/gate evidence now require the exact A response contract and F2 Stage02 route minimum. The bounded source universe, independence and no-universal-completeness restriction remain.
decisions.SEARCH_CONFLICT_COMPLETENESS: The proposal’s asserted current-status effect needs reconciliation with otherwise retained analogous semantic-status fields; this class is not accepted solely from its label.
decisions.RESEARCH_COMPLETENESS: Current researched coverage, complete passes/challenges/reconciliations and corresponding gate summaries now use A/F2 accepted external operations. Every accepted source/unit and the valid no-applicable-source exception remain. C does not redefine independently retrieved external source units.
decisions.REQUIREMENT_DISPOSITION_REVIEW_COMPLETEN: Current valid disposition and completed independent challenge/reconciliation depend on A/F2 admission and input evidence. Every original obligation remains traceable; the new basis is no semantic disposition or classification waiver.
decisions.REQUIREMENT_SET_REVIEW_COMPLETENESS: The completed independent resolution/blocking judgments and gate evidence now use the exact A/F2 external review contract. Missing evidence cannot establish resolution; classification definitions and human/agent authority stay unchanged.
decisions.ACCEPTED_TEST_INPUT: The accepted test semantic input now includes B current availability relationship, D valid native definition/semantics and E exact variance contract. Admission, immutable freeze and accepted proof review stay distinct; applicable XML ambiguity remains qualified.
decisions.INSTRUCTION_COMPLETION: Current instruction acceptance and complete instruction trace/gate evidence now use A/F2 Stage08 COMPLETE. F1 receipt-only execution cannot substitute for ordinary instruction authoring or its every-requirement trace.
decisions.PREFLIGHT_ACCEPTED_COVERAGE: Current accepted preflight coverage and absence of unresolved material findings depend on A/F2 admitted review with exact input support. This does not change the separate independence predicate or authorize execution during ordinary preflight.
decisions.FROZEN_VARIANCE_COMPONENT: E changes the frozen candidate’s normalized variance component and its exact test/source/scope/hash bindings. The whole normalized object includes nonoperative extension context; frozen bytes are not accepted semantic review.
decisions.NATIVE_CONFIGURATION_IDENTITY: D changes the effective native registry/parser/selector configuration identity. The field must bind the current configuration or explicit equivalent migration; application ownership does not preserve an incompatible old registry.
decisions.RUN_EXACT_INPUT_BINDING: F2 now fixes the accepted Stage11 package/member input-support minimum. The exact own-run package restriction remains; echo/support is not observed external possession or hidden provider separation.
decisions.RUN_ACCEPTED_RESPONSE: A/F2 change current accepted run response admission and resulting accepted-run/gate projections. Base3088 excludes failed/rejected/blocked attempts; exactly ten current reserved accepted runs and distinct contexts remain.
decisions.RUN_FROZEN_VARIANCE_REFERENCE: E changes the exact normalized frozen variance bytes and bindings carried in the run package. It does not make extension context executable or allow per-run reinterpretation.
decisions.DUE_PER_RUN_COMPLETENESS: B changes the current due relation’s accepted availability operand; D changes current native results; F1/F2 add bounded applicable receipt and input-evidence governors, and A governs external response admission. Existing due phase, exactly-one tuple and no fabricated cells remain; unresolved bindings/XML effects are conditional.
decisions.PER_RUN_VALID_DETERMINATION: Current exactly-one valid tuple determination acquires B/D current availability and result semantics plus A/F2 external admission where relevant. Error/unknown/stale states cannot become favorable proof.
decisions.PER_RUN_SUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: F2 supplies the required external input minimum for sufficient Stage12 tuple evidence. Every stronger/distinct proof and independence condition still applies; echoes alone do not establish the proposition.
decisions.DUE_DOMAIN_EXCLUSION: B closes the target-availability operand of the original due predicate. UNKNOWN is not FALSE and cannot remove a potentially due cell; unchanged phase timing and future visibility remain.
decisions.ACCEPTED_RUN_POPULATION: Base3088 explicitly selects accepted current runs. A/F2 therefore govern this Stage12 RUNS population while exactly-ten cardinality and rejection of superseded attempts remain.
decisions.RCA_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE: A/F2 govern current accepted evidence-supported RCA, its confirmed/blocked outcomes and gate evidence. Every material defect still needs supported causal analysis or an honest blocker; semantic cause description and earliest-layer responsibility remain.
decisions.BASELINE_CONFIRMATION_PREREQUISITE: The successful current confirmation prerequisite consumes amended B/D/E/F1/F2 verification and variance semantics, plus A for external responses. Byte immutability and human baseline authorization are separate requirements; old favorable confirmation is not inherited.
decisions.PRODUCTION_INPUT_BINDING: F2 now closes exact external Stage21 baseline input support. No broader context is admitted; receiving/supplying bytes and echoes remain epistemically distinct.
decisions.PRODUCTION_ACCEPTED_EXECUTION: A/F2 govern accepted current production execution records and completion evidence. Fresh context, actual output bytes, lineage and application identities remain independently required.
decisions.CURRENT_NATIVE_EXECUTION: B governs readiness while D fixes exact supported native semantics and terminal outcomes. The every-ready-test execution requirement remains; no run or accepted result is established by source review.
decisions.EXTERNAL_CAPABILITY_FALLBACK: D affects native expressibility and F2 affects admissible external input support. Unsupported native work remains mandatory/blocked unless the exact authorized external capability and bytes are available; no automatic executor substitution is inferred.
decisions.DETERMINISTIC_CURRENT_RESULTS: Current sufficient deterministic outcomes/gates require B current availability, D native semantics and A/F2 external route admission where applicable. Every applicable mandatory test still requires exactly one current sufficient satisfied result.
decisions.DETERMINISTIC_TEST_DOMAIN: Applicability, mandatory status and mechanical-test classification are not readiness. B does not remove potentially due obligations when availability is UNKNOWN, and unsupported native capability does not remove the deterministic obligation.
decisions.VALIDATOR_SEMANTIC_VERSION: D requires fresh affected validator/parser/selector registry identity or explicit verified equivalence. This exact current semantic-version reference cannot retain an incompatible old identity.
decisions.MEANING_REVIEW_INPUT: F2 adds the exact input-support minimum to the already authorized-only Stage23 context; product/requirement/source/rubric authorization boundaries and semantic independence remain.
decisions.MEANING_REVIEW_ACCEPTANCE: A/F2 govern current admitted independent meaning reviews, evidence/determination/completion projections. Location, required/observed meaning and comparison content remain required; echoes are not semantic proof.
decisions.ADVERSARIAL_EXECUTION_COMPLETENESS: Current attack/regression testing and evidence/outcome completeness acquire B/D/F1/F2 effective execution governors and A external admission. Every applicable category/pattern and unresolved finding remains present, with isolated disposable execution and honest blockers.
decisions.REPRESENTATION_INSPECTION_ACCEPTANCE: A/F2 govern the external final-inspection route and its accepted coverage/evidence. Human-only judgment keeps its proper basis; exact frozen delivery set membership remains. Intake ZIP counting does not replace final page/view/package inspection.
decisions.PROCESS_PRODUCT_AUDIT_COMPLETENESS: Current process/product evidence sufficiency and progression must include all applicable amended intake, fallback, due/test, variance, route and input-evidence governors. Ownership and raw counts cannot substitute for this current conjunction.
decisions.CURRENT_RELEASE_UNIVERSE: The complete current due release-evidence universe and Stage26 prerequisite acquire all applicable amendments. Original REJECTED/BLOCKED/ACCEPTED precedence, one idempotent application result and optional nongating advisory review remain.
decisions.RELEASE_DEPENDENT_IDENTITY_GATE: The current Stage27 accepted prerequisite and resulting authorization consequence inherit the amended release predicate. Exact delivery bytes and destination-bound human intent remain distinct; these commands receive no new external minimum.
decisions.EVIDENCE_CHAIN_CURRENT_SCOPE: B/D/E change current proof, execution-registry and variance bindings that a current-scope chain must reference. Literal artifact ID linkage alone does not establish semantic dependency currentness.
decisions.EVIDENCE_CHAIN_SUFFICIENCY: Current structurally complete/evidence-sufficient chains and completeness/gate projections require every applicable amended provenance, native/variance/availability, receipt and input-basis link. No link count supplies missing semantic evidence.
decisions.CURRENT_REPRODUCTION_INSTRUCTIONS: Reproduction content must specify current B/D/E/F1/F2 execution, predicate, variance and input-basis meaning. Historical prose cannot reinterpret an incompatible registry or conflate pre/post executions.
decisions.TERMINAL_PREREQUISITE_COMPLETENESS: The terminal prerequisite/integrity/hash/determination conjunction consumes amended upstream current evidence. The existing atomic commit, self-validity, append-only history and no release/terminal cycle remain; authorization still does not prove transfer.
decisions.DUE_REGRESSION_EXECUTION_CURRENTNESS: Current due regression execution and future-baseline receipts use B/D/F1/F2 current due, compatibility, identity, outcome and input custody, plus A external admission. Future tests remain visible/unexecuted; definition writers and append-only history remain.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_01_PROPOSITION: Full raw request and human-only question authority remain; C projected blank-line accounting cannot hide raw text. Stage01 still cannot perform source research, atomization, test design or final production.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_02_PROPOSITION: External-source independence, noninvention, every candidate disposition and explicit conflict/discovery-risk blocking remain. Supplied raw artifacts do not become independent authority. Current accepted review/completion effects are separate.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_03_PROPOSITION: Every accepted external source and the six material extraction categories, conflict/exception passes and source lineage remain. A/F2 accepted coverage effects do not redefine those categories or make agent semantic text application-owned.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_04_PROPOSITION: The complete current obligation union, every-obligation provenance/atomicity and no-repeat-human-input rules remain. Requirement classification and objective truth-condition form are separate from current review admission.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_05_PROPOSITION: Semantic issue categories, detecting contradictions/duplicates/prerequisites, changed requirement versioning and downstream invalidation remain. A/F2 current independent resolution effects do not redefine what a conflict or missing prerequisite is. Ambiguous status-summary retentions are separately blocked.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_08_PROPOSITION: The instruction retains every mandatory requirement, accepted requirement source, required sections/procedure/tools/outputs/failure handling and traceability. Accepted current tests and instruction-completion predicates are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_09_PROPOSITION: Ordinary preflight reviews clauses without executing the project; required independence, correction versioning and repeat review remain. Its separate later F1 test route cannot authorize execution within preflight.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_10_PROPOSITION: Human component selection, exact immutable bytes, component presence, same-package distribution and literal identity allocation remain. Changed normalized variance and native configuration dependencies are separately recorded.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_11_PROPOSITION: Ten distinct current reserved runs/contexts, isolation, exclusion of other outputs/later findings, separate receipts/output and exact candidate hash equality remain. Accepted-response and exact input-support dependencies are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_12_PROPOSITION: Independent verifier role/context restriction and no meaningless Cartesian tuples remain. B due-status and D current outcome effects are separately changed, never converted into requirement inapplicability.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_14_PROPOSITION: Every material defect traces to the earliest defective layer; an unknown cause remains blocked. Defect/cause identity and semantic description are not native outputs. Accepted confirmation/blocking versus undetermined-cause field classification is explicitly isolated for further review.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_20_PROPOSITION: Human baseline authority, actual byte/version freeze, complete immutable components and baseline identity allocation remain. Current unchanged-confirmation success is an independent changed prerequisite.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_21_PROPOSITION: Fresh production context, actual output byte/hash/inventory/lineage and application allocated identity remain. Only authorized approved baseline inputs are allowed; current input/response admission changes are separate.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_22_PROPOSITION: The visible explanation and mechanical-test population remain. Readiness, native/external capability, current result semantics and validator identity are separately changed; unavailable/unsupported tests do not disappear from scope.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_23_PROPOSITION: Review comparison/location/required/observed meaning and independent evaluator identity remain. A/F2 changes admissible current review/evidence outcomes, not the meaning of the semantic content fields.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_24_PROPOSITION: The product is challenged with isolated attacks and historical regressions; unresolved mandatory findings still require defects/blockers. Applicable execution/evidence outcome changes are separately identified.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_25_PROPOSITION: Exact frozen delivery-candidate IDs, filenames, membership, transformations, byte/hash facts and change invalidation remain. Page/view/packaged-file universe is not replaced by C1 raw-intake counting; accepted external inspection is separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_26_PROPOSITION: Application identity/count ownership and the obligation to reconcile or block contradictions/discrepancies remain. Actual current audit/evidence sufficiency and progression are separately changed.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_27_PROPOSITION: Advisory review remains optional, nongating and confined to its family. No agent/human sets release; exact precedence and total requirement membership remain. Current due/evidence result calculations change separately.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_28_PROPOSITION: Same current Stage25 delivery set, exact one-to-one byte match, prohibited rename/extra/missing/transform changes and destination/purpose/channel/disclosure/validity-bound human intent remain. Current release dependency is separate.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_29_PROPOSITION: Application chain builder, missing-evidence-only investigation, mandatory requirement population, repository location and applicable artifact identity links remain. Current scope, structural/evidence sufficiency and reproduction content change separately.
decisions.PRESERVED_STAGE_30_PROPOSITION: One terminal transaction/revision/commit, own-commit validity, append-only histories, new correction records, permanent regressions, no cycles and separately receipted transfer remain. Current due regression/registry/prerequisite/result computations change separately.
decisions.STATUS_FIELD_DISPUTE_3504: Stage02 UNRESOLVED_CONTROLLING_CONFLICTS is proposed CHANGED through A/F2 admission, while the analogous Stage05 UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS is proposed RETAINED as semantic classification. The source/default summary rule alone does not justify this asymmetric effective-context decision. Review whether each field counts semantic issue state or accepted current resolution outcomes, preserving missing-review blockers.
decisions.STATUS_FIELD_DISPUTE_3595: Stage05 UNRESOLVED_CONFLICTS retention is not adequately distinguished from the proposed changed Stage02 unresolved-controlling-conflict summary. The semantic conflict definition is preserved, but accepted resolution versus raw semantic issue-state populations need one explicit source-grounded derivation decision.
decisions.CORRECTION_3689: F2 explicitly preserves stronger/distinct dimensioned-independence requirements and does not turn input echoes into hidden independence. Base3323 independence is one conjunct, separate from admitted clause review and no-unresolved-finding completeness. The proposal conflates the added input-binding conjunct with a changed independence predicate. Preserve this exact independence obligation; current overall preflight acceptance remains separately changed.
decisions.STATUS_FIELD_DISPUTE_3818: Stage14 UNDETERMINED_ROOT_CAUSES is proposed RETAINED while CONFIRMED_ROOT_CAUSES and BLOCKED_ANALYSES change through A/F2. Unknown cause content is not the same as missing admissible review. The proposal does not establish whether this summary counts content-level unknown causes, current accepted UNKNOWN reviews, or both. Preserve unknowns and block the identity decision pending the bounded source derivation distinction.
decisions.CORRECTION_4029: The applicable mandatory deterministic-test population is a classification/scope predicate, not the ready native-test population. Base1279–1283 separates due target availability from applicability, and base4320–4323 keeps unsupported tests blocked or executable through required external capability/bytes. B/D can change current readiness/admitted results or registry identities; they cannot delete a mandatory deterministic obligation because its target is unavailable or native execution unsupported. The proposal conflates those domains. Preserve this exact population definition without carrying old counts/results.
